verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships its own Post-Incident Reviews feature. The docs show PIRs started from the incident detail page or Slack, AI-generated PIRs, chronological narratives built from incident lifecycle and Slack data, Scribe Agent transcripts feeding the review, and coordinated follow-up actions. That covers the drafting-from-timeline part of the story well, but nothing in the evidence documents templates, a review/approval step, or publication. missing for 10: PIR templates, a documented review/approval workflow, publication/sharing of finished postmortems, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, postmortems follow a real workflow — templates, drafting from the timeline, review, and publication

citations.quote: Post-Incident Reviews integrate with your incident lifecycle, Slack data, and the PagerDuty Advance Scribe Agent to help your team uncover systemic patterns, build chronological incident narratives
Teams can start PIRs directly from the incident detail page or Slack after resolving an incident
Transcribe incident meetings in real time to enhance incident summaries and post-incident reviews
